root_cause_criterion.criterion: After `UA_free(dst->data)` on the decode-failure path, `dst->data` must be set to `NULL` before returning to generic cleanup.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable error branch frees the newly allocated `UA_LocalizedText` body but leaves `dst->data` unchanged. The fixed program nulls `dst->data` immediately after that free, so the later `UA_deleteMembers()` / `Variant_clear()` cleanup does not reuse the freed pointer.

nodes.state: `String_clear()` receives the freed `UA_LocalizedText.locale` object as `s` and performs the ASan-reported read of `s->data` / `s->length` at the sink.
`Variant_clear()` sees the partially built Variant with `p->data` still equal to the freed `UA_LocalizedText` pointer and prepares it for one-element `UA_Array_delete()` cleanup.

edges.relation: The same stale `UA_LocalizedText *` base pointer that `Variant_clear()` passes into `UA_Array_delete()` reaches `String_clear()` as its `s` argument via `LocalizedText_clear(&p->locale, NULL)`.
Because the error branch frees `dst->data` without nulling it, the same stale pointer value survives into the later `Variant_clear()` cleanup and is reused after the free.
